paul_support: P1 -> CS: Veridian Health trial blocked. SSO /auth/callback returning 500; embed iframe sometimes 504. Pilot demo in ~2h. Escalating to CS for priority handling.

anya_cs: Ack. Please paste short error output + org id and region. I'll draft a one-paragraph comms and tag renewal risk.

paul_support: Org: veridian-health (org_9081), region: eu-west-1. Errors: `ERROR /auth/callback 500 upstream connect failure x-request-id=7a9b3c` and `iframe load 504 after 30s -> https://embed.redwood.ai/v1/render?tenant=veridian-health`.

omar_se: Quick triage: recent edge deploy likely stripped query params (RelayState) on redirects. Fastest mitigation is a targeted rollback; I can also push a middleware defensive fix but that'll take ~40m.

lucy_pm: If the demo misses, renewal signal drops. Comms plan: 1) acknowledge within 10m, 2) offer screenshare demo, 3) update in 30m with ETA. Anya lead comms, I'll standby for exec escalate.

anya_cs: Draft outbound: "Hi Sarah we're investigating an auth + embed issue that may affect today's demo. Engineering is on it. We can run the demo via screenshare as scheduled or reschedule. I'll update in 30 minutes. Thanks, Anya (Customer Success)" Marking cs_renewal_risk=true on org meta.

infra-bot: incident INC-3234567890 created; severity=high; assigned=omar_se.

omar_se: Rollback command: `edgectl rollback --service edge-proxy --to 2026-03-22T19:45:00Z` then `edgectl purge --tenant veridian-health`. Request approval to run rollback now for faster mitigation.

anya_cs: Approve rollback. I'll tell the customer we're prioritizing a mitigation and offering screenshare.

omar_se: Executed rollback at +18m and purged tenant cache. Running smoke: auth callbacks returning 200, embed renders stable in eu-west-1.

paul_support: Verified from support console: no 500s observed in the last 10m. Updated ticket RED-7623 with mitigation notes. Closing emergency bridge after customer confirms.

lucy_pm: Created product backlog ticket `embed-guard-relaystate` with acceptance criteria and e2e tests. Tagging urgent and linking to INC-3234567890.

anya_cs: Customer accepted screenshare demo and appreciated the quick fix. Scheduling 24h follow-up to capture feedback and reassess renewal signal. Closing thread unless anything changes. :white_check_mark:
